title: Pag-IBIG Fund brings over 20,000 homes, special offers to Mindanao Housing Fair on Nov. 12–13

blocks.text: Pag-IBIG Fund is bringing more than 20,000 housing units from over 45 participating developers to the Mindanao Housing Fair 2026 on November 12–13 at the SMX Convention Center in Davao City, giving Filipino workers and their families more opportunities to find homes suited to their needs and budgets through affordable financing and special offers under the government’s Expanded Pambansang Pabahay para sa Pilipino (Expanded 4PH) Program. “The Expanded 4PH Program is bringing decent and affordable homes within reach of more Filipino families across the country, and we are already seeing strong results in helping more Filipinos achieve homeownership.
